chunks: And in the narration of Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abū Maryam, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, the last time I met him, about a boy who had not reached puberty who had relations with a woman or committed fornication with a woman: what is to be done with them? He said:
The boy is beaten short of the hadd punishment, and the hadd is carried out upon the woman.
So I said: A young girl who has not reached puberty is found with a man committing fornication with her. He said:
The young girl is beaten short of the hadd punishment, and the hadd is carried out upon the man.

key_terms.الْحَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.جَارِيَةٌ: a young girl or female minor
key_terms.دُونَ الْحَدِّ: less than the full prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if fornication occurs between an adult and a child who has not reached puberty in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning illicit intercourse involving a minor who has not reached puberty. It states that the minor is disciplined short of the full hadd punishment, while the legally accountable adult party is subject to the hadd.
